Domains

Domains organize devices into a naming hierarchy: a device placed in one is addressed as device.subdomain.domain. Every device belongs to a domain; new organizations start with the karst root. A domain's admin can create subdomains under it and delegate their administration to another user, without granting that user access to the rest of the account.
